description: This file defines the interface ITlsHandshakeFeature which specifies properties related to TLS handshake information such as protocols, algorithms, and strengths.

classes.name: ITlsHandshakeFeature
classes.description: Interface that provides TLS handshake details including protocol, cipher, hash, and key exchange information.

methods.name: Protocol
methods.description: Property that gets the SSL/TLS protocol version.

methods.name: CipherAlgorithm
methods.description: Property that gets the cipher algorithm used.

methods.name: CipherStrength
methods.description: Property that gets the strength of the cipher.

methods.name: HashAlgorithm
methods.description: Property that gets the hash algorithm used.

methods.name: HashStrength
methods.description: Property that gets the strength of the hash.

methods.name: KeyExchangeAlgorithm
methods.description: Property that gets the key exchange algorithm.

methods.name: KeyExchangeStrength
methods.description: Property that gets the strength of the key exchange.
